managedIndustrialEthernetSolution: The NAV-I-10R4S is a Gigabit managed industrial Ethernet fiber switch featuring 10x 10/100/1000Base-T adaptive RJ45 ports and 4x 100/1000Base-X uplink SFP fiber ports. Designed for harsh environments, it supports wire-speed forwarding and comprehensive L2+ network management.
robustIndustrialBuild: Features an IP40 rated aluminum alloy housing with a fanless thermal design and 6KV lightning protection. It operates stably in extreme temperatures ranging from -40°C to +80°C.
networkRedundancy: Supports ERPS ring network protocols (recovery time <20ms) and STP/RSTP/MSTP. This eliminates Layer 2 loops and ensures uninterrupted communication for critical applications.
advancedSecurity: Includes comprehensive security mechanisms such as 802.1X authentication, port isolation, and broadcast storm suppression. Supports easy management via Web, CLI, and SNMP.
idealFor: Industrial scenarios such as intelligent transportation, rail transit, and green energy construction. The NAV-I-10R4S offers flexible port combinations (Gigabit RJ45+SFP) and diverse management modes to build economical, efficient, and stable communication networks.
productOverview: The NAV-I-10R4S is a Gigabit managed industrial Ethernet fiber switch. It is equipped with 10x 10/100/1000Base-T adaptive RJ45 ports and 4x 100/1000Base-X uplink SFP fiber ports. Each port supports wire-speed forwarding. The NAV-I-10R4S features L2+ network management functions, including IPv4/IPv6 management, static routing forwarding, comprehensive security protection mechanisms, advanced ACL/QoS strategies, and rich VLAN functions for ease of management and maintenance. It supports multiple network redundancy protocols, including STP/RSTP/MSTP (<50ms) and ERPS (ITU-T G.8032) ring networks (<20ms), to enhance link backup and network reliability. If a unidirectional network fails, communication is quickly restored to ensure the uninterrupted operation of critical applications. Designed for harsh environments, the switch offers excellent adaptability to mechanical stress, extreme climates, and electromagnetic interference. It is ideal for industrial scenarios such as intelligent transportation, rail transit, power industries, mining, petroleum, shipping, metallurgy, and green energy construction.

smartPoEPowerSupply: Supports IEEE 802.3af/at standards with up to 30W per port. productOverview: The NAV-P-24P8S-4S is a Layer 3 (L3) managed PoE fiber switch featuring 10G uplinks, independently developed to meet high-density network requirements. The device is equipped with 24x 10/100/1000Base-T adaptive RJ45 ports, 8x 100/1000Base-X SFP fiber ports, and $4\times1/10\text{G}$ uplink SFP+ fiber ports. Ports 1-24 support the IEEE 802.3af/at PoE standard, capable of delivering up to 30W per port. Designed for versatility, the NAV-P-24P8S-4S is suitable for a wide range of environments, including hotels, campuses, parks, supermarkets, factories, and small-to-medium enterprises (SMBs), providing a cost-effective networking solution. The switch features comprehensive L3 network management capabilities, including IPv4/IPv6 management, dynamic routing, and forwarding. It incorporates robust security mechanisms, complete ACL/QoS policies, and extensive VLAN functions for easy maintenance. To ensure network reliability, it supports multiple redundancy protocols such as STP/RSTP/MSTP (<50ms) and ERPS (ITU-T G.8032). If a network link fails, communication is quickly restored to ensure uninterrupted application performance. Users can configure various services-such as PoE power management, traffic control, VLAN division, and SNMP-via a web-based management interface.

overview.title: Product Overview
paragraphs: Network Monitoring System helps administrators track network devices, availability, performance, and alerts from one centralized platform.
It is designed for enterprises, campuses, transport hubs, hospitality, healthcare, and public infrastructure environments that need dependable network visibility.
The platform supports proactive monitoring workflows so teams can identify issues early, reduce downtime, and maintain service continuity.

features: Centralized dashboard for live network health visibility
Device availability and uptime tracking
Traffic, bandwidth, and performance monitoring
Event-based alerts for faster troubleshooting
Operational reports for network performance review
Historical visibility for capacity planning
Supports monitoring across switches, controllers, access points, and network devices
Helps reduce downtime through proactive issue detection
Built for scalable enterprise network operations

products.title: Under Vehicle Surveillance System
products.tagline: Automated under-vehicle inspection and security screening
products.description: Under Vehicle Surveillance System helps security teams inspect vehicle undercarriages with recorded visual evidence, faster screening workflows, and centralized review for checkpoints and high-security locations.
products.heroDescription: A vehicle inspection solution for checkpoints, campuses, logistics facilities, government sites, and other secure premises that need fast under-vehicle visibility and reliable screening records.

overview.title: Product Overview
paragraphs: UVSS provides a practical inspection workflow for monitoring the underside of vehicles as they pass through a security checkpoint.
It is designed for premises where vehicle screening, evidence capture, and fast operator review are important for daily security operations.
The system supports organized inspection records and helps teams improve throughput while maintaining consistent screening standards.

features: Under-vehicle visual inspection for checkpoint screening
Supports faster review of vehicle undercarriage areas
Designed for repeatable daily security operations
Useful for controlled entries and high-security premises
Helps maintain vehicle screening records
Supports operator-led review and incident follow-up
Suitable for campuses, government facilities, logistics hubs, and parking entries
Can be integrated into physical security workflows
Built for vehicle access control environments

operations.recordKeeping: Supports inspection evidence and review workflows
operations.useCases: Security screening, access control, and incident review
